items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Franco Jobai used to play the saxophone. So I brought my saxophone.

ctx.x: I was playing triangle. Then, when I got here, I went to the Paramount Theater, to the -- Paul Weinman. They just got through playing the Rhapsody in Blue. And my friend in love with the saxophone. Franco Jobai used to play the saxophone. So I brought my saxophone. We went back to Cuba, and 15 day after we recorded, we went to Cuba. So I started playing my saxophone.
